headline: As of 2026-10-17: 8,762,834 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 39 of 50 states, D+19.8 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 8,762,834 early/mail ballots cast so far across 39 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+19.8 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (1,201,759), Florida (827,915), Georgia (775,995).
